description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipController class, responsible for handling employee membership-related views and data preparation in the OrangeHRM system. It manages interactions such as fetching services, preparing components with properties, and setting permissions for the employee membership interface.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipController
classes.description: Controller class managing the employee membership view and data flow for the HRM system, extending BaseViewEmployeeController and utilizing various services and components for rendering employee membership details.

methods.name: getMembershipService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of MembersipService used within the controller.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Retrieves the PayGradeService instance from the service container.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and UI components before rendering the employee membership view, including setting properties like currencies, memberships, and permissions.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups relevant for capability permission checks, here returning ['membership'].
